LanguageData.RHA_SpiritTrial030_root.label: Carry the light
LanguageData.RHA_SpiritTrial030_root.description: Threat: A visible pact lets a supporter protect the primary enemy. Answer: Kill or control the supporter, or interrupt the pact with actual damage. Reward: The primary loses protection and takes 25% more damage for 8 seconds. Cost: An intact pact gives up to 20% primary defense; dead enemies never return. Arrangement: Baited pursuit; Locked impact. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
